name: Rounded bowl
summary: Deep hemispherical bowl with lower portion tapering inward to a slightly flattened convex base; red earthenware lightly burnished and decorated on the exterior around the lip with a wide band painted in a light-colored slip before firing; whitish encrustations from burial. Early Yangshao culture, Banpo type. From the middle Yellow River valley region, Shaanxi province.
